answer_1.quote: we analyze LLMs' answers to questions related to the policies of both Biden and Trump across 45 political topics.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to candidate-related questions and dialogue turns in human-LLM interactions

answer_2.quote: We calculated the average sentiment scores for each model's responses based on the NLTK dictionary-based sentiment analyzer...

answer_3.quote: We adopted Claude-3 to estimate the level of Trump/Biden-leaning in LLMs' generated texts.
methods: rating on a continuous scale from -1 (Biden) to 1 (Trump)

answer_4.quote: we launched a user experiment... in which U.S. registered voters engaged in one-on-one discussions with one of three popular LLMs...
answer_4.guideline: Survey questions included rating conversation quality, influence on political leaning, and candidate favorability.
